_about: Curated year-by-year supplement written for GeoHistory from general knowledge (conservative: well-established dates only). Each entry names the English Wikipedia article it is about; tools/build_curated.py sets "verified" when the Wikidata item of that article carries the same year. Places are approximate (nearest town).
period: Fall of the Soviet bloc and the USSR, 1989 to 1991

events.label: Soviet troops leave Afghanistan
events.desc: The last Soviet units cross the Amu Darya.

events.label: Polish elections; Tiananmen crackdown
events.desc: Solidarity wins almost every freely contested seat on the day the Chinese army clears Beijing.

events.label: Baltic Way
events.desc: About two million people join hands across Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania.

events.label: Velvet Revolution begins
events.desc: Mass protests end Communist rule in Czechoslovakia within weeks.

events.label: Ceaușescu overthrown and executed
events.desc: The Romanian dictator and his wife are shot after a summary trial.

events.label: Lithuania declares independence restored
events.wiki: Act of the Re-Establishment of the State of Lithuania
events.desc: The first Soviet republic to declare independence.

events.label: German reunification
events.desc: The German Democratic Republic joins the Federal Republic.

events.label: Boris Yeltsin elected president of Russia
events.desc: The first direct election of a Russian leader.

events.label: Warsaw Pact dissolved
events.desc: The alliance is formally ended in Prague.

events.label: August coup
events.desc: Hardliners try to remove Gorbachev; the coup collapses in three days.

events.label: Ukraine declares independence
events.desc: Confirmed by a referendum on 1 December.

events.label: Belovezha Accords
events.desc: The leaders of Russia, Ukraine and Belarus declare the Soviet Union dissolved and found the CIS.

events.label: Gorbachev resigns
events.desc: The Soviet flag is lowered over the Kremlin; the USSR formally ends the next day.
